name: moodle-image-generator
description: Servicio de generación de imágenes con IA para Moodle usando Gemini

scripts.copy-public: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist/public')) fs.mkdirSync('dist/public', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('public', 'dist/public', {recursive: true});"
